name: Alex Cissell
fact: Cissell was still authoring SGA legislation two sessions after her committee chairmanship: she wrote the 2023-24 Hope Harbor X Denim Day funding bill and presented it to the senate on 12 March 2024 with Senator at Large Sophia Bryant, by then a senior public relations student. The Herald photograph of that presentation shows a woman; the archive's 2021-22 profile paragraph refers to Cissell as "he", which appears to be an unsourced inference and should be checked.

name: Eric Smiley
fact: Smiley was chapter president of Sigma Chi while serving in SGA; the Herald ran him in a February 2011 feature on the four Greek chapter presidents then sitting in the Student Government Association.

name: Katie Stillwell
fact: Stillwell was chapter president of the Omega Pi Alpha sorority while serving in SGA, one of the four Greek presidents the Herald profiled in February 2011.

name: Kaylee Egerer
fact: As Campus Improvements chair Egerer carried Resolution 2-11-S, supporting the Downing University Center renovation with a student fee capped at $70 a semester until the project was paid off; the senate approved it on 22 February 2011.

name: Charlie Harris
fact: Harris was a political science major from Morganfield who co-founded WKUAID and organised campus campaigns including fair trade and One Planet Day alongside his SGA work.

name: Kate Hart
fact: Hart travelled with the SGA cabinet to Frankfort in February 2016 to lobby state legislators, including House Majority Whip Johnny Bell, over budget proposals affecting education.

name: Wade Pierce
fact: Pierce was a Lambda Chi Alpha member from Louisville; his fraternity brother Devon Hinderbrandt ran unopposed to succeed him as administrative vice president in the April 2011 SGA election.

name: Paige Settles
fact: Settles competed on the WKU forensics team, presenting the Top Novice after-dinner speaking award at a September 2015 tournament.

name: Murphy Burke
fact: Burke, then a sophomore, put a question to the WKU presidential search committee at its student forum in Downing Student Union on 27 April 2016, answered by Frederick Higdon, Jay Todd Richey and Barbara Burch.

name: Antonina Clementi
fact: Clementi appears in the front row of the Herald's April 2022 group photograph of WKU forensics team award winners, a year before her term as Secretary of the Senate.
